namespace = boi_housing_events

# ================================================================
#  Burden of Infrastructure — housing events (2026-11-08)
#  Generated by tools/Build-HousingEvents.py; do not edit by hand.
#  Plan 6, "Proposed housing events". All numbers are test values.
#
#   .1    hidden yearly dispatcher: one 3% roll for each event
#   Employer housing:
#   .10   The Company Store         .11   Tied Cottage Evictions
#   .12   Disaster at the Camp      .13   A Model Village
#   .14   The Pullman Strike
#   Residential housing:
#   .20   A Tenement Collapses      .21   The Rent Strike
#   .22   A Philanthropist's Offer (rehousing pledge)
#   .23   A Royal Commission on Housing
#   .24   The Great Fire (20-year cooldown; any wood-heated housing)
#   .25   A Suburban Building Bubble
#   .26   Red Vienna (once)
#  Each event cools down 5-15 years per country from when it fires.
# ================================================================

boi_housing_events.1 = {
	type = country_event
	hidden = yes

	trigger = { NOT = { is_country_type = decentralized } }

	immediate = {
		random_list = {
			3 = { trigger_event = { id = boi_housing_events.10 popup = yes } }
			3 = { trigger_event = { id = boi_housing_events.11 popup = yes } }
			3 = { trigger_event = { id = boi_housing_events.12 popup = yes } }
			3 = { trigger_event = { id = boi_housing_events.13 popup = yes } }
			3 = { trigger_event = { id = boi_housing_events.14 popup = yes } }
			3 = { trigger_event = { id = boi_housing_events.20 popup = yes } }
			3 = { trigger_event = { id = boi_housing_events.21 popup = yes } }
			3 = { trigger_event = { id = boi_housing_events.22 popup = yes } }
			3 = { trigger_event = { id = boi_housing_events.23 popup = yes } }
			3 = { trigger_event = { id = boi_housing_events.24 popup = yes } }
			3 = { trigger_event = { id = boi_housing_events.25 popup = yes } }
			3 = { trigger_event = { id = boi_housing_events.26 popup = yes } }
			64 = {}
		}
	}
}

boi_housing_events.10 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:hev_state
	title = boi_housing_events.10.t
	desc = boi_housing_events.10.d
	flavor = boi_housing_events.10.f
	event_image = { video = "europenorthamerica_capitalists_meeting" }
	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_scales.dds"
	duration = 3

	trigger = {
		NOT = { has_variable = boi_hev_company_store_cd }
		has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_no_workers_rights
		boi_hev_camp_levels >= 10
		any_scope_state = { boi_hev_state_camp_levels >= 3 }
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = { name = boi_hev_company_store_cd value = yes years = 5 }
		ordered_scope_state = {
			limit = { boi_hev_state_camp_levels >= 3 }
			order_by = boi_hev_state_camp_levels
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = hev_state
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = boi_housing_events.10.a
		ig:ig_industrialists ?= {
			add_modifier = { name = boi_hev_ig_angered days = 730 is_decaying = yes }
		}
		ig:ig_trade_unions ?= {
			add_modifier = { name = boi_hev_ig_pleased days = 730 is_decaying = yes }
		}
		ai_chance = { base = 1 }
	}

	option = {
		name = boi_housing_events.10.b
		default_option = yes
		scope:hev_state = {
			add_radicals_in_state = {
				value = medium_radicals
				pop_type = laborers
			}
		}
		ai_chance = { base = 2 }
	}
}

boi_housing_events.20 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:hev_state
	title = boi_housing_events.20.t
	desc = boi_housing_events.20.d
	flavor = boi_housing_events.20.f
	event_image = { video = "unspecific_devastation" }
	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_skull.dds"
	duration = 3

	trigger = {
		NOT = { has_variable = boi_hev_collapse_cd }
		NOT = { has_law = law_type:law_boi_residential_standards }
		any_scope_state = {
			boi_cm_state_low_tier_levels >= 3
			sg:boi_housing = { state_goods_pricier >= 0.5 }
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = { name = boi_hev_collapse_cd value = yes years = 5 }
		ordered_scope_state = {
			limit = { boi_cm_state_low_tier_levels >= 3 sg:boi_housing = { state_goods_pricier >= 0.5 } }
			order_by = boi_cm_state_low_tier_levels
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = hev_state
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = boi_housing_events.20.a
		ig:ig_intelligentsia ?= {
			add_modifier = { name = boi_hev_ig_pleased days = 730 is_decaying = yes }
		}
		ig:ig_trade_unions ?= {
			add_modifier = { name = boi_hev_ig_pleased days = 730 is_decaying = yes }
		}
		ig:ig_landowners ?= {
			add_modifier = { name = boi_hev_ig_angered days = 730 is_decaying = yes }
		}
		ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie ?= {
			add_modifier = { name = boi_hev_ig_angered days = 730 is_decaying = yes }

boi_housing_events.24 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:hev_state
	title = boi_housing_events.24.t
	desc = boi_housing_events.24.d
	flavor = boi_housing_events.24.f
	event_image = { video = "unspecific_devastation" }
	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_skull.dds"
	duration = 3

	trigger = {
		NOT = { has_variable = boi_hev_great_fire_cd }
		any_scope_state = { boi_hev_state_wood_fire = yes }
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = { name = boi_hev_great_fire_cd value = yes years = 20 }
		ordered_scope_state = {
			limit = { boi_hev_state_wood_fire = yes }
			order_by = boi_cm_state_low_tier_levels
			position = 0
			check_range_bounds = no
			save_scope_as = hev_state
		}
		scope:hev_state = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						has_building = building_boi_slums
						has_building = building_boi_tenements
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { has_building = building_boi_slums }
					remove_building = building_boi_slums
				}
				if = {
					limit = { has_building = building_boi_tenements }
					remove_building = building_boi_tenements
				}
			}
			else = {
				ordered_scope_building = {
					limit = { boi_hev_building_wood_fire = yes }
					order_by = boi_hev_building_smallness
					position = 0
					check_range_bounds = no
					save_scope_as = burned_housing
				}
				if = {
					limit = { exists = scope:burned_housing }
					if = {
						limit = { scope:burned_housing = { is_building_type = building_boi_slums } }
						remove_building = building_boi_slums
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { scope:burned_housing = { is_building_type = building_boi_tenements } }
						remove_building = building_boi_tenements
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { scope:burned_housing = { is_building_type = building_boi_regulated_terraces } }
						remove_building = building_boi_regulated_terraces
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { scope:burned_housing = { is_building_type = building_boi_tenement_blocks } }
						remove_building = building_boi_tenement_blocks
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { scope:burned_housing = { is_building_type = building_boi_model_dwellings } }
						remove_building = building_boi_model_dwellings
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { scope:burned_housing = { is_building_type = building_boi_apartments } }
						remove_building = building_boi_apartments
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { scope:burned_housing = { is_building_type = building_boi_municipal_estates } }
						remove_building = building_boi_municipal_estates
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { scope:burned_housing = { is_building_type = building_boi_elevator_apartments } }
						remove_building = building_boi_elevator_apartments
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { scope:burned_housing = { is_building_type = building_boi_luxury_apartments } }
						remove_building = building_boi_luxury_apartments
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { scope:burned_housing = { is_building_type = building_boi_boulevard_apartments } }
						remove_building = building_boi_boulevard_apartments
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { scope:burned_housing = { is_building_type = building_boi_elevator_residences } }
						remove_building = building_boi_elevator_residences
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { scope:burned_housing = { is_building_type = building_boi_suburbs } }
						remove_building = building_boi_suburbs
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { scope:burned_housing = { is_building_type = building_boi_railway_suburbs } }
						remove_building = building_boi_railway_suburbs
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { scope:burned_housing = { is_building_type = building_boi_streetcar_suburbs } }
						remove_building = building_boi_streetcar_suburbs
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { scope:burned_housing = { is_building_type = building_boi_motor_suburbs } }
						remove_building = building_boi_motor_suburbs
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { any_scope_building = { boi_hev_building_urban_industry = yes } }
				add_modifier = { name = boi_hev_great_fire_works years = 3 }
			}
			add_modifier = { name = boi_hev_great_fire years = 1 }
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = boi_housing_events.24.a
		add_treasury = boi_hev_payment_large
		custom_tooltip = boi_housing_events.24.a.tt
		scope:hev_state = {
			add_modifier = { name = boi_cm_modernised_city years = 5 }
			# The permanent ban on new Slums and Rows only once a working-class
			# replacement can be built: Regulated Terraces need urban_planning (C4).
			if = {
				limit = { owner = { has_technology_researched = urban_planning } }
				set_variable = boi_modernised_city
			}
		}
		ai_chance = { base = 1 }
	}

	option = {
		name = boi_housing_events.24.b
		default_option = yes
		ai_chance = { base = 2 }
	}
}

boi_housing_events.25 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:hev_state
	title = boi_housing_events.25.t
	desc = boi_housing_events.25.d
	flavor = boi_housing_events.25.f
	event_image = { video = "europenorthamerica_capitalists_meeting" }
	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_scales.dds"
	duration = 3

	trigger = {
		NOT = { has_variable = boi_hev_bubble_cd }
		boi_hev_cheap_luxury_states >= 3
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = { name = boi_hev_bubble_cd value = yes years = 10 }
		capital = { save_scope_as = hev_state }
	}

	option = {
		name = boi_housing_events.25.a
		add_treasury = boi_hev_payment_large
		ig:ig_industrialists ?= {
			add_modifier = { name = boi_hev_ig_pleased days = 730 is_decaying = yes }
		}
		ai_chance = { base = 1 }
	}

	option = {
		name = boi_housing_events.25.b
		default_option = yes
		add_radicals = {
			value = small_radicals
			strata = middle
		}
		add_modifier = { name = boi_hev_building_crash years = 1 }
		ai_chance = { base = 2 }
	}
}

boi_housing_events.26 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = scope:hev_state
	title = boi_housing_events.26.t
	desc = boi_housing_events.26.d
	flavor = boi_housing_events.26.f
	event_image = { video = "unspecific_world_fair" }
	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_industry.dds"
	duration = 3

	trigger = {
		NOT = { has_variable = boi_hev_red_vienna_done }
		boi_hev_socialist_government = yes
		boi_hev_municipal_levels >= 10
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = boi_hev_red_vienna_done
		capital = { save_scope_as = hev_state }
	}

	option = {
		name = boi_housing_events.26.a
		default_option = yes
		add_modifier = { name = boi_hev_red_vienna years = 10 }
		ig:ig_trade_unions ?= {
			add_modifier = { name = boi_hev_ig_pleased days = 730 is_decaying = yes }
		}
		ai_chance = { base = 1 }
	}
}
